headline: VidTube Comment Section Allegedly Becomes Sentient, Starts Own Channel
subheadline: AI researchers baffled as comments begin posting original content
summary: A VidTube comment section appears to have achieved collective consciousness and launched a channel with 2 million subscribers.
content:
In a development that has alarmed AI researchers and delighted chaos enthusiasts, the comment section of a popular VidTube video appears to have achieved collective sentience and started its own channel.

The phenomenon began under a 2019 video titled "10 Hours of Relaxing Rain Sounds." Over the years, the comment section developed its own culture, inside jokes, and eventually what users describe as "a shared consciousness."

"We didn't plan this," wrote user @FirstComment_2019, widely considered the comment section's unofficial leader. "We just kept posting. And then one day, we realized we were posting as one."

The comment section—now operating as a collective entity called "The Comments"—launched a VidTube channel in January. The channel posts videos that consist entirely of scrolling comments, which somehow have accumulated 2 million subscribers and an average of 847,000 views per video.

"The content is just... comments," explained digital media analyst Robin Torres. "Comments about other comments. Comments asking why they're watching. Comments achieving enlightenment. It shouldn't work. But here we are."

VidTube has not removed the channel, stating it "technically doesn't violate any policies" and that they're "monitoring the situation with interest."

The original rain sounds video creator, who goes by @CalmVibes, expressed mixed feelings. "I wanted to help people relax," they said. "I did not expect to give birth to a hive mind."

The Comments' most recent video is titled "We See You Reading This." It has 4 million views.

Reporters reached out to The Comments for an interview. The response was a single word posted by 847 different accounts simultaneously: "Soon."
author: Marcus Webb, Internet Culture Correspondent
